properties.note: Chosen by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --priority as a place to start: among the cells holding Nigeria's densest quarter of buildings (from 523 bldg/km2), the 1 km window with the most roof area in buildings of 1,000 m2 or more (100 such buildings, 43.2 ha of roof; 1,231 buildings in all, 1,231 per km2, VIDA).
